subject: Quick thoughts on your portfolio site + live preview
body: Hi Aryan, I came across your work building production-grade Python infrastructures and Next.js dashboards, and I was especially impressed by how you optimized the Julius media processing pipeline to drop render times from 30 minutes to under 5 minutes. While reviewing your site at aryansharmaswe.vercel.app, I noticed a couple of minor opportunities to help prospective clients reach out faster, such as adding a direct contact action and structured schema markup for your portfolio. I went ahead and built a live prototype of your site that addresses these items while refining the dark tech layout. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://4b00e0c0.nayom-aryansharmaswe-vercel-app.pages.dev. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added direct contact links for easier recruiter and client outreach
Implemented structured metadata and OpenGraph tags for better profile visibility
